units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 6:27">Targ. Prov. VI, 27</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 11:15">Ib. XI, 15</cite>.—V. <cite ref="U00433"><he>שׂוּם</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Gittin 56b:3">Gitt. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>הוה סיים חד וכ׳</he> he had tied (put on) one shoe.
<cite ref="Taanit 22a:4">Taan. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>הוה סיים וכ׳</he> used to wear black shoes; a. e.
<cite ref="Ezekiel 24:17">Ez. XXIV, 17</cite>). Gitt. l. c. <he>בעא למְסַיְּימָא וכ׳</he> he wanted to put on the other shoe.
<cite ref="Taanit 12b:3">Taan. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>דמסַיְּימֵי מסנייהו וכ׳</he> that they wear their shoes and come to the fast-meeting.
<cite ref="Taanit 12b:4">Ib.</cite> <he>כי מסיימי וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="A02746"><he>אַפַּנְתָּא</he></cite>; a. e.

senses.gloss: to mark, define. Y. Sabb. VI, 8ᶜ bot. סַיְּימוּן וכן וכ׳ they marked (the time), and so it was.—Part. pass. מְסַיַּים.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 100a:9">B. Bath. 100ᵃ</cite> <he>דמְסיְּימָן מחיצתא</he> when the partitions are distinctly defined; a. e.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 44:18">Targ. Y. Gen. XLIV, 18</cite> Tosefta (ed. <cite ref="M00911"><he>מחסיל</he></cite>).—

<cite ref="Megillah 25a:8">Meg. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>סַיַּימְתִּינְהוּ לשבחיה וכ׳</he> hast thou exhausted all the praises of the Lord? <cite ref="Berakhot 12a:10">Ber. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>פתח … דשכרא וס׳ בדחמרא</he> he began the benediction under the impression that it was beer, and closed with the benediction over wine.
<cite ref="Berakhot 17a:4">Ib. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>כי הוה מְסַיֵּים צלותיה וכ׳</he> when he closed his prayer, he said &c.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 76b:11">B. Mets. 76ᵇ</cite> <he>סַיְּימוּהָ קמיה</he> they cited it (the Boraitha) before him to the end; a. fr.—Part. pass. as ab.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:11">Cant. R. to I, 11</cite> <he>מְסַיְּימָה</he>, v. <cite ref="H01900"><he>חֲתַם</he></cite>.—[<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 8:9">Targ. Y. I Deut. VIII, 9</cite> <he>מסימין</he>, v. <cite ref="H01398"><he>חֲסַם</he></cite>.]
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 16b">Ab. Zar. 16ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>מינאי ומינך תִּסְתַּיֵּים שמעתתא</he> this tradition will be named from myself and from thee.
<cite ref="Shabbat 31b:3">Sabb. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>תסתיים דר׳ וכ׳</he> it can be conclusively proved that it was R. … who said &c.; <he>תסתיים</he> it is proved.
